entities.name: GlmU
observations: Query sequence is 451 aa and matches reviewed GlmU homolog Q98LX2 at 51.9% identity and 98.9% query coverage (E=2.87e-142); assignment is homology-supported.
GlmU catalyzes the final two sequential steps of UDP-N-acetylglucosamine biosynthesis: acetylation of glucosamine-1-phosphate and UMP transfer from UTP to N-acetylglucosamine-1-phosphate.
Reviewed homolog annotations report Mg2+ binding; do not treat this as experimentally confirmed for the query sequence.

entities.name: GlmU acetylation
observations: alpha-D-glucosamine 1-phosphate + acetyl-CoA = N-acetyl-alpha-D-glucosamine 1-phosphate + CoA + H+ (Rhea RHEA:13725); assigned to the C-terminal acetyltransferase domain in curated homologs.

entities.name: GlmU uridylylation
observations: N-acetyl-alpha-D-glucosamine 1-phosphate + UTP + H+ = UDP-N-acetyl-alpha-D-glucosamine + diphosphate (Rhea RHEA:13509); assigned to the N-terminal nucleotidyltransferase domain in curated homologs.
